instruct: A woman's voice, low-warm and unhurried, speaking close and quietly as if at your shoulder in a lamplit workshop — intimate but composed, with precise economical diction. Calm master-craftswoman confidence; a subtle audible smile at the edges, never performed. Whole, undivided attention.

text: Here — try it now. The handle has stopped arguing with your hand, and that little snag you kept tripping on is gone. You did the work; I only moved a buckle. Mm — look at that. I do love watching a mortal become.
